svg.text: storage chests (double chests and barrels work)
one full-block wired modem between two chests joins both
right-click each modem: it turns red
• A small wired modem only goes on a full block: chests need a full-block modem touching them; barrels take a small one
• Turtles' chests (builders, crafters, remote terminals) find themselves: don't pick them in 'storage setup'.
• ME or RS: an ME Bridge / RS Bridge touching the system, with a wired modem on the cable (see Example layouts).
